items.title: New York State halts construction of all new data centers
items.summary: New York has become the first state to temporarily halt approval of large data centers, as Gov. Kathy Hochul argues the AI-driven building boom shouldn’t come at the expense of higher electricity costs, water supplies, or local control.
items.titleZh: 纽约州停止所有新数据中心的建设
items.summaryZh: 纽约州已成为第一个暂时停止批准大型数据中心的州，因为州长凯西·霍楚尔认为，人工智能驱动的建筑热潮不应该以更高的电力成本、供水或地方控制为代价。

items.title: Iran abused mobile networks' vulnerabilities to locate U.S. military in the Middle East, report says
items.summary: The Iranian government exploited well-known flaws in cellphone networks to locate and then strike U.S. military personnel in the build-up and beginning of the war.
items.titleZh: 报告称，伊朗利用移动网络的漏洞在中东找到美军
items.summaryZh: 在战争的准备和开始阶段，伊朗政府利用手机网络中众所周知的缺陷来定位并打击美国军事人员。

items.title: Gallup CEO says colonizing Mars may be closer than fixing today’s ‘broken’ workplace—where disengagement levels are as high as 2020
items.summary: Four in five workers are disengaged. And Gallup CEO Jon Clifton warns there’s no recovery in sight: ‘We're closer to colonizing Mars.’
items.titleZh: 盖洛普首席执行官表示，殖民火星可能比修复今天“破碎”的工作场所更接近——在那里，脱离接触的程度高达2020年
items.summaryZh: 五分之四的工人没有工作。盖洛普首席执行官乔恩·克利夫顿警告说，复苏遥遥无期：“我们离殖民火星更近了。”

items.title: These Volkswagen EVs could soon disappear, including Audi and Porsche models
items.summary: With plans to slash its lineup by up to 50%, several Volkswagen EVs, including those under the Audi and Porsche brands, may not be around for much longer.
items.titleZh: 这些大众电动汽车可能很快就会消失，包括奥迪和保时捷车型
items.summaryZh: 由于计划将其产品线削减高达50%，包括奥迪和保时捷品牌在内的几款大众电动汽车可能不会存在太久。

items.title: Earnings season plays: Profit expectations are growing for these stocks while their valuations get cheaper
items.summary: Investors can find opportunities in stocks where declining share prices are pushing valuations below their historical average.
items.titleZh: 财报季表现：这些股票的利润预期正在增长，而其估值却在下降
items.summaryZh: 投资者可以在股价下跌导致估值低于历史平均水平的股票中找到机会。

items.summaryZh: OpenAI在今年的大部分时间里都卷入了一场又一场的诉讼，其中包括一场来自世界首富的诉讼。但上周五，该公司遭到了迄今为止最引人注目的法律诉讼之一——来自苹果的诉讼。OpenAI昂贵的硬件赌注是…

items.titleZh: 优步在自动驾驶竞赛中失利。现在它想写规则
items.summaryZh: 优步在制造自动驾驶汽车的竞赛中失利。现在，它想为所有这样做的人制定规则。在美国的两个州，该公司正在游说制定法律，强制将机器人轴安装到其应用程序中，其自己的产品主管很乐意解释原因。优步无法赢得这场比赛…

items.title: Tesla moves to guarantee resale value for buyers after price cuts
items.summary:
Tesla is launching a new “guaranteed future value” (GFV) program that locks in a pre-set resale price for buyers financing a new Model Y or Model 3.
The move directly targets the depreciation fears that have followed Tesla’s own aggressive price cuts over the…
items.titleZh: 特斯拉在降价后采取行动保证买家的转售价值
items.summaryZh: 特斯拉正在推出一项新的“保证未来价值”（GFV）计划，该计划为资助新款Model Y或Model 3的买家锁定了预设的转售价格。
